remarks: Spacious unit located in the heart of the SONO District. Features an updated open-concept kitchen and in-unit washer and dryer. Secure building with elevator and a shared outdoor space with grill. Bright and sunny apartment with large windows in both the living room and bedroom.  Enjoy easy access to New York City just a 3-minute drive or 8-min walk to the South Norwalk Train Station. Conveniently located within walking distance to everything SONO has to offer, including restaurants, theater, nightlife, the Maritime Aquarium, and shopping. Short drive to Calf Pasture Beach, SONO Mall, and John H. Ryan Park right around the corner.  No pets. No smoking. Tenant responsible for a $100 move-in/move-out fee. Full credit report (must have good credit), proof of income, and references required. Photos were taken prior current tenants moving in.
